sports_fact.text: On September 6, 1995, Cal Ripken Jr. played his 2,131st consecutive game, passing Lou Gehrig. The ovation lasted 22 minutes and he was pushed into a lap around Camden Yards.

quote.text: The hero of the Odyssey is a great fighter, a wily schemer, a ready speaker, a man of stout heart and broad wisdom who knows that he must endure without too much complaining what the gods send; and he can both build and sail a boat, drive a furrow as straight as anyone, beat a young braggart at throwing the discus, challenge the Pheacian youth at boxing, wrestling or running; flay, skin, cut up and cook an ox, and be moved to tears by a song. He is in fact an excellent all-rounder; he has surpassing aretê.
quote.author: Robert M. Pirsig
